```{r}

# Install packages
install.packages(c("WDI", "tidyverse"))

# Load required libraries
library(WDI)
library(tidyverse)

```
```{r}
# Download data (use 2022 for now but later we need to explain why 2022)
edu_raw <- WDI(
  country = "all",
  indicator = wdi_vars,
  start = 2022,
  end = 2022,
  extra = TRUE,   # includes income group
  cache = NULL
)
```

```{r}
# Define WDI indicator codes(we can add more variables later)
wdi_vars <- c(
  "SE.ADT.1524.LT.ZS",   # Youth literacy rate (% ages 15–24)
  "IT.NET.USER.ZS",       # Internet users (% of population)
  "NY.GDP.PCAP.CD"         # GDP per capita (current US$)
)

# Clean and rename manually
edu_clean <- edu_raw %>%
  filter(region != "Aggregates") %>%  # Remove regional summary rows
  select(
    country,
    youth_literacy = `SE.ADT.1524.LT.ZS`,
    internet = `IT.NET.USER.ZS`,
    gdp_per_capita = `NY.GDP.PCAP.CD`,
    income
  ) %>%
  drop_na()  # Drop rows with missing values

# Preview
head(edu_clean)
```
